title: Model Entry Window & Supply Fragility Dashboard spec
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Purpose: produce a single-pane dashboard and API surface that quantifies two complementary market signals for Redwood: (1) 'entry window' — the expected useful competitive lifetime of a newly onboarded open model flavor for our customers, and (2) 'supply fragility' — a composite score capturing vendor availability risk, quantization/compatibility friction, and regional provisioning constraints.

Scope: specify metrics, data sources, visualization wireframes, alerting thresholds, and an initial Looker/Grafana implementation plan. Deliverables: dashboard spec doc, sample SQL queries / telemetry joins, metric definitions (with formulas), alert rules, and a prioritized rollout plan for product/solutions teams.

Why this matters: product and sales need a concise signal to decide when to (a) onboard a new model, (b) commit spend to Dedicated capacity for a flavor, and (c) trigger fallbacks or procurement actions when supply fragility rises. Current artifacts are fragmented across Sheets and ad-hoc telemetry; this ticket consolidates and formalizes metrics and a reliable dashboard.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Metrics defined with unambiguous formulas and data sources (time windows, denominators).
2) Prototype dashboard in Grafana or Looker rendering baseline signals for past 12 months.
3) Alert rules for: entry_window < 30 days, supply_fragility > 0.7, geo-availability drop > 20% within 24h.
4) Example queries and a reproducible pipeline (SQL / Airflow DAG) checked in under model-observatory repo.
5) Product sign-off (PM + Solutions) and Engineering feasibility review recorded in comments.

Decisions & trade-offs:
- Rolling-window vs event-based entry window: we will expose both but surface rolling-window as the primary to reduce churn noise.
- Granularity: start weekly aggregation, with an option to drill to daily for incident troubleshooting.
- Privacy/compliance: procurement_lead_time will be aggregated to team-level; no customer PII will be exposed in dashboards.
